thesis: Reusable operation libraries and coherent text worlds make resource-relative novelty and consequence preservation experimentally testable.
role: Define tests of composition, semantic interpretation and targeted revision.

ideas.statement: Functional novelty increases tasks solvable within a budget and differs from renaming an operation or receiving an external primitive.
Text-world tests separate interpretation from consequence execution, preserve ambiguity and assess semantics independently of wording.
Provenance should support selective belief revision measured by correct and unnecessary retractions, contradictions and recomputation cost.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Compare fixed, memorized, learned-parameterized and supplied libraries using amortized time and reuse on new tasks.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No observed saturation in a finite experiment does not establish unlimited innovation.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
